title: Pentanuclear sandwich-type ZnII-LnIII clusters based on a new Salen-like salicylamide ligand: Structure, near-infrared emission and magnetic properties

material_class.structural_family: sandwich-type pentanuclear Zn2Ln3 cluster with hydroxyl-bridged Ln3 core

synthesis.procedure: General procedure: to 20 mL acetonitrile containing 0.1 mmol (0.028 g) H3L was added 27 μL (0.2 mmol) triethylamine. After stirring 5 min, 0.1 mmol (0.021 g) Zn(NO3)2·H2O in 5 mL acetonitrile was added and the mixture was stirred for another 4 h to give a suspension. 5 mL methanol was added to obtain a clear solution, then 0.1 mmol Ln(NO3)3·6H2O (Ln = Er) was added. The mixture was stirred overnight, filtered into a sealed 10–20 mL glass vial and left for slow evaporation. After about three weeks pale yellow single crystals were collected by filtration, washed with cold methanol, and dried in air. Yield for Zn2Er3: 44.2 mg, 55% based on Er(NO3)3·6H2O.
synthesis.time: 5 min + 4 h stirring, then overnight stirring; crystallization about three weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution self-assembly with slow evaporation in a sealed 10–20 mL glass vial
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered into a sealed vial for slow evaporation; pale yellow crystals collected by filtration, washed with cold methanol, dried in air

properties.summary: Displays ligand-centered visible emission and weak ErIII NIR emission (4I13/2 → 4I15/2) via zinc/ligand antenna sensitization in MeOH/MeCN and similarly in the solid state. DC magnetism shows antiferromagnetic interactions and incomplete magnetization saturation; zero-field AC data indicate frequency-dependent out-of-phase signals below 10 K consistent with slow relaxation/possible SMM behavior with a small barrier and QTM.

measurements.name: NIR emission assignment
measurements.conditions: excitation of zinc/ligand-centered absorption; solution (MeOH/MeCN 1:4) and similar solid-state spectra

measurements.name: magnetization M
measurements.conditions: 2 K, field up to 70 kOe; no obvious hysteresis at 100 Oe/s sweep

measurements.name: AC slow relaxation
measurements.value: frequency-dependent χ″ below 10 K at 0 Oe; χ″ peaks still not observed under 2000 Oe
measurements.conditions: 2–10 K, 3 Oe ac field, frequencies 400–3000 Hz; 0 Oe and 2000 Oe dc

material_class.structural_family: sandwich-type pentanuclear Zn2Ln3 cluster with hydroxyl-bridged Ln3 core

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same general procedure as Zn2Er3 using 0.1 mmol Yb(NO3)3·6H2O in place of the Er salt: H3L (0.1 mmol, 0.028 g) and NEt3 (27 μL, 0.2 mmol) in 20 mL acetonitrile, addition of Zn(NO3)2·H2O (0.1 mmol, 0.021 g) in 5 mL acetonitrile, 4 h stirring, addition of 5 mL methanol then Ln salt, overnight stirring, filtration into a sealed vial and slow evaporation for about three weeks. Pale yellow crystals collected, washed with cold methanol, dried in air. Yield: 49.4 mg, 61% based on Yb(NO3)3·6H2O.
synthesis.time: 5 min + 4 h stirring, then overnight stirring; crystallization about three weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution self-assembly with slow evaporation in a sealed 10–20 mL glass vial
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered into a sealed vial for slow evaporation; pale yellow crystals collected by filtration, washed with cold methanol, dried in air

properties.summary: Isostructural sandwich cluster showing ligand-centered visible emission and strong YbIII NIR emission (2F5/2 → 2F7/2) after zinc/ligand-centered excitation; solid-state luminescence similar to solution, indicating the cluster is retained in solution. No magnetic data reported for this analogue.
